title: Sandstorms
author: Dark Sun Engine
description: Weather for the open desert: now and then a sandstorm sweeps the Tablelands. In the open-desert regions one blows in each six hours of game time, for 10 to 30 minutes. While it does, drifting sand in the region's own colours blows over the map with Dust Cloud's sound, softly; in a fight begun in it no one sees farther than 4 squares, missiles are -4 to hit, and clouds and fog blow away after a round. Off: the original's clear skies.
